title: Fruits and Vegetable Products - Determination of Water-Insoluble Solids
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13845) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Fruits and Vegetable Products - Determination of Water-Insoluble Solids.

chemical_properties: ash them with the same juice and then with 50 %
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
